summary: The root هدي (hdy) primarily means to guide or lead someone on the right path, often with the implication of showing the way or directing.

headwords.gloss: He directed him; guided him; directed him aright

parts.t: (MA, KL) to her husband, (MA,) or to the house of her husband: (KL;)
: see an ex. in a verse cited voce

headwords.def: هَدَاهُ He directed him, or guided him, to the way; (K, * TA;) directed him aright; or caused him to take, or follow, a right way or course or direction. (K, TA.) See 8. هَدَى العَرُوسَ He sent [or conducted ] the bride (MA, KL) to her husband, (MA,) or to the house of her husband: (KL;) i. q. زَفَّهَا , (K in art. زف ,) and so . (Msb in that art.) يَهْدِى meaning يُؤَدِّى : see an ex. in a verse cited voce طَبَعٌ .

headwords.def: تَهَادَنَا They (two parties who had been at war) made a truce, each with the other. (T, art. نبذ .)

headwords.def: اِهْتَدَى He became rightly directed; followed a right direction; (K;) went aright; as also . (S.) He guided himself. He went a right way: went aright. لَا يَهْتَدِى إِلَى جِهَةٍ He cannot go aright: or knows not the way that he would pursue; or knows not in what direction to go: sometimes said of a drunken man. لَا يَهْتَدِى لِأَمْرِهِ means He does not, or cannot, find the way to accomplish, or perform, his affair. اِهْتَدَى He found, (MA,) or took (KL,) the right way or road. (MA, KL.) دَاهِيَةُ لاَ يُهْتَدَى لَهَا , by which دَاهِيَةُ الغَبَرِ is expl. in the S and O, means لَا يُهْتَدَى للَّنَّجَآءِ مِنْهَا , by which the same phrase is expl. in the JK: or it may be well rendered A calamity in relation to which one knows not the right course to pursue.

headwords.gloss: A way, course, method, mode; manner, of acting; conduct

parts.t: : (K:) or to the second and third: and the first is pl. [or coll. gen. n.] of the last: (S:) and

headwords.def: هَدْىٌ A way, course, method, mode, or manner, of acting, or conduct, or proceeding, or the like; (Msb, K;) as also and : (K:) or to the second and third: and the first is pl. [or coll. gen. n.] of the last: (S:) and a god way, &c.: and calm, or placid, deportment; or calmness, or placidity, of deportment: (TA:) see also دَلٌ . هَدْىٌ [ Conduct, mode of life; manners ]. See هَدِىٌّ .

headwords.gloss: He is following; he follows, a right direction; The Kur-án
headwords.def: هُوَ عَلَى هُدًى He is following, or he follows, a right direction. الهُدَى The Kur-án. (Bd, Jel in lxxii. 13, &c.)

headwords.gloss: A present; a thing sent to another in token of courtesy; honour

parts.t: a thing sent to another in token of courtesy
What one brings as an offering to Mekkeh,
One who is entitled to respect,
so in a verse cited voce

headwords.def: هَدِيَّةٌ [n. un. of هَدِىٌّ ] A present; i. e. a thing sent to another in token of courtesy or honour: (Msb;) such as is termed طَرِيفٌ and لَطَفٌ . (JK.) and هَدِىٌّ [coll. gen. ns.] What one brings as an offering to Mekkeh, (K,) or to the Kaabeh, (Beyd, v. 2,) or to the Haram, (S, Mgh,) consisting of camels (Lth, S, Mgh, Msb) or other beasts, (Lth,) namely kine or sheep or goats, (Mgh,) to be sacrificed, (TA,) and of goods or commodities: (Lth:) n. un. with ة . (S, &c.) Also, Camels, absolutely. (TA.) هَدِىٌّ also One who is entitled to respect, or honour, or protection: so in a verse cited voce اِسْتَبَآءَ . (ISk in T in art. بوأ .)

headwords.def: هَادٍ : see an ex. of its pl. هَوَادِى meaning Necks of horses, voce تَالٍ . هَادِيَةٌ The fore part of the neck of a horse. (K in art. سلف .) أَخَذَ هَادِىَ الرَّحَى فَجَعَلَ يُدِيرُهَا [ He took the handle of the mill, and begun to turn it ]. (K, art. خبز .)
أَهْدَى مِنْ دُعَيْمِيصِ الرَّمْلِ More expert, &c: see art. دعمص .

headwords.def: المَهْدِىُّ , meaning The directed by God to the truth, is a proper name, and the name of him of whose coming at the end of time the happy tidings have been announced. (TA.) [It is always so pronounced by the Arabs in the present day: not المُهْدِى .]
